subject: physics
title: Redshift and the Expanding Universe
welcome_lead: Stretch a wavelength with z = Δλ/λ and discover the universe is expanding.
meta_desc: A-Level Cosmology adventure on redshift and recession velocity of galaxies.
final_note: Redshift z ≈ v/c at non-relativistic speeds — direct evidence of expansion.

concepts.def: Frequency shift due to relative motion.

walkthroughs.body_html: Wavelength shift over original wavelength. Positive z means receding source; negative z (blueshift) means approaching. For small z, v ≈ cz.
Doppler arises from peculiar motion through space. Cosmological redshift comes from space itself expanding while light travels. Both look like z = Δλ/λ.
Slipher first noted most galaxies show redshift. Hubble showed greater distance correlates with greater z — the universe is expanding.

mcqs.q: What does the cosmological redshift of distant galaxies indicate?
options: Space itself is expanding, stretching the wavelength of light from distant galaxies as it travels.
Only when the force is small enough to be ignored.
Galaxies are moving through space away from us, like objects flying outward from a centre.
The galaxies are turning red because they are getting older.

mcqs.q: Is the cosmological redshift of distant galaxies a true Doppler shift?
options: No — it is caused by dust in space absorbing blue light.
No — it arises from the expansion of space stretching photon wavelengths during transit, not from the galaxy's motion through space.
Yes — it is the same Doppler shift as a moving siren on Earth.
The galaxies are turning red because they are getting older.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Distant galaxies”?
options: Frequency shift due to relative motion.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Cosmological redshift”?
options: Frequency shift due to relative motion.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Redshift z”?
options: Frequency shift due to relative motion.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Recession velocity”?
Which of these is the best definition of “Doppler effect (light)”?
options: Frequency shift due to relative motion.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Blueshift”?
options: Frequency shift due to relative motion.
